title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the distance moved by m2 before coming to rest.

title: Use of Lagrangian
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate an understanding of the Lagrangian formulation and its application to the problem.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the conservation of momentum to relate the velocities of m1 and m2 after the impulse.

title: Explanation for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide a clear explanation of why the system cannot rotate without oscillation.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: The student should include appropriate units in their final answer and throughout their calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when applying equations of motion.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure all necessary factors, such as mass ratios or spring constants, are included in their calculations.
